reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a new temporal motion—the car pulling forward out of the dark—which overrides the subject plate's static pose.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the existing live-action rendering with no conversion requested, and the schema pins medium ownership to the reference.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested, so the observed carbon fibre body attributes carry over from the reference.
reasons.lighting: 'Out of the dark' expresses mood/setting rather than an illuminating source, direction or visible light quality, so the reference showroom lighting remains in force.
reasons.framing: The car moving forward is subject motion, not an actual camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement request; framing stays reference-governed.
reasons.palette: No scene color palette is requested; the car's black finish is an incidental object color and does not recolor the scene, so the reference palette governs.
